column3: NKJV includes “named,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV includes “Christ” twice (“our Lord Jesus Christ”), following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “our Lord Jesus” both times.
NKJV has “the day of the Lord Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the day of the Lord.”
NKJV includes “for us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
